title: Professional Security Operations Engineer
overview: A Google Cloud Certified Professional Security Operations Engineer detects, monitors, analyzes, investigates, and responds to security threats against workloads, endpoints, and infrastructure. This individual uses Google Cloud resources to protect an enterprise environment and is proficient in writing detection rules, log prioritization and ingestion, orchestration, and response automation.
